top_signals.title: Top Philippine Power Retailer to Refund Clients $156 Million
top_signals.summary: Manila Electric Co., the Philippines’ largest power distributor, was ordered by the regulator to refund 9.5 billion pesos ($156 million), representing excess charges to customers.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: South Korea’s Leveraged ETF Trading Plummets Under New Curbs
top_signals.summary: Trading in leveraged exchange-traded funds tied to South Korea’s two chip giants has shrunk sharply, after authorities took steps to slow demand for the products that fueled recent market volatility.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Confusion Over India NSE Closing Auction Turbocharges Nifty Rally
top_signals.summary: The new rules were meant to improve price discovery and curb manipulation in the final stretch of trading.

top_signals.title: DEXs capture record 24% of spot crypto trading as CEX volumes sink
top_signals.summary: Spot exchange volume is on track to set a new 12-month low at $670 million, down from its annual high of $2.23 trillion.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Two employees were sent back into Kumamoto mall before explosion
top_signals.summary: At a wake held for one of the two Habita employees who died in the incident, bereaved family members told Habita's president that they would "never forgive" the company.
